# deferred-search-debounce

Behavior contract:
debounce(fn, delay, scheduler) returns a callable with flush() and cancel(). scheduler.set(callback,delay) returns an opaque handle (0 is valid); scheduler.clear(handle) removes it. Calls replace pending arguments and receiver, scheduling exactly one trailing invocation after delay. Normal calls return undefined. flush() runs a pending invocation immediately once with the latest this/arguments and returns its result; no pending work yields undefined. cancel() discards pending work. Clear pending state before invoking fn so fn can schedule another call reentrantly. No real clock is required.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
